input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a Vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position on every material term: commercial general liability of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (appropriate given Vendor hosts Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17), and workers' compensation as required by law. Coverage runs throughout the term plus one year, matching the model language, and employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 is additional cover beyond what we ask for. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all of which benefit us. The notice-of-cancellation undertaking is qualified by "to the extent available from its insurer", a minor sub-element short of an absolute obligation that is noted here rather than flagged. No redline required.
